messages:
adan: Heads up — after the kernel-selector refactor host CPU on ingress jumped ~3-4x for small requests (<1KB). gRPC streaming p50/p95 climbed; lots of tiny writev syscalls and tokenizer CPU.
marta: saw the same on canary. pprof points at net.writev + tokenizer.Tokenize hot paths; KV cache miss rate spiked for same traffic shape.
adan: forcing pre-refactor selector brings numbers back down, so selector change looks like the trigger.
sahil: diff shows we switched many variants to latency-first kernels. For short sequences that reduces batching (selector prefers single-request kernels) => smaller batches + more syscalls.
jun: parser is now slicing streams per-frame instead of coalescing multiple small frames, increasing syscall overhead on host before GPU.
marta: quick pprof snippet: 
30.1% net.Writev
21.4% tokenizer.Tokenize
12.0% runtime.mallocgc
8.5% ingress.ParseFrame
6.0% kvcache.Lookup (miss)
Matches flamegraph.
adan: also seeing HPACK header churn increase when we don't coalesce — header table penalties on many small frames.
sahil: mitigation proposal: revert kernel-policy flip for small-seq traffic + re-enable stream coalescing at proxy. Also set min_batch_size=4 for latency-first kernels.
jun: agree. We should expose kernel selection decision metrics (kernel_policy, chosen_kernel, estimated_batch_size) so live behavior is visible. Currently opaque.
marta: I'll prototype a proxy coalesce: buffer up to 8 frames or 2ms, whichever first, then flush. Should cut writev frequency with minimal latency impact.
adan: plan: canary A/B — rollback selector + proxy coalesce. If good, refine selector heuristics.
ci-bot: jun/test-kernel-rollback triggered - smoke tests running.
deploy-bot: canary rollback in us-east-2 started by adan.
sahil: followups: add metric redwood_runtime_kernel_policy_choice (label), gauge ingress_coalesce_buffer_depth, and a trace span around tokenizer -> kvcache lookup to correlate misses.
marta: i'll own the proxy coalesce PR, opening in 10m. Need pprof and syscall traces for canary.
jun: i'll capture pprof and syscall traces: `pprof -http=:6060 ./profiles/cpu.pprof` and `sudo perf record -e syscalls:sys_enter_writev -a -g -- sleep 30`.
adan: if rollback+coalesce don't fully fix tail, consider cheap host-side tokenization to estimate token counts pre-selection so batching heuristics select appropriately.
marta: note: KV eviction looked worse for multitenant small requests — might be eviction policy side-effect of refactor. I'll add eviction_hit_rate metric.
sahil: on watch for canary, will report numbers. :thumbsup:
adan: captured; will update when canary numbers land.
